x-disallowedQueryParameters.description: Query parameter names, compared case-insensitively, that track the sharer or carry credentials. A URL using any of them must be resubmitted without them.

title.description: The public title deliberately supplied for this candidate.

url.description: Canonical public HTTP(S) URL only: no credentials or fragments. Query parameters are allowed when they identify public content, such as YouTube v, but tracking, share, and credential parameters listed in x-disallowedQueryParameters are rejected.

date.description: The intended public date in ISO 8601 calendar form.

image.description: Optional canonical public image URL with the same credential, fragment, and query parameter policy as the destination URL.

take.description: Optional, exact first-person wording supplied by Kaleb. Never generated or transformed by the system.

draft.description: Capture requests are drafts and require normal editorial review before publication.
